summary.intent: Generate a structured milestone summary for v1.1, document all tech debt as tracked todos, and open a docs PR so new contributors can onboard and deferred work is formally tracked.
summary.outcome: PR #515 opened on branch docs/milestone-v1.1-summary-and-tech-debt with MILESTONE_SUMMARY-v1.1.md, TECH_DEBT-v1.1.md, 5 net-new pending todos (24 code-verified open findings), a BACKLOG.md pointer section, and a ROADMAP correction fixing stale summary sections that had omitted 16 phases.

repo: The project uses per-component semver tags (cipher-box-vX.Y.Z), not milestone-level tags (v1.1), so milestone git stats require falling back to earliest-phase-commit date boundaries.
.planning/ is in .markdownlintignore, so pre-commit markdownlint/lint-staged never validates planning docs.
Tech debt is tracked in two tiers: .planning/BACKLOG.md (consolidated inventory) and .planning/todos/pending/*.md (dated, structured actionable files). Net-new items must go in both.
The ledger close-out commits (#512/#513) covered phases 19.2/23/27/47–49, NOT phases 18/31/32 — those three still lack VERIFICATION.md and PERF-01..04 requirements remain orphaned.

Phase 43 REVIEW.md has a 'Post-Review Resolution (2026-06-14)' section confirming all 8 criticals were fixed; phases 45/46 closed most of its warnings. Phase 42 REVIEW.md has no resolution section — all 12 WR/IN findings remain open.
Phase 27's detail block in ROADMAP.md sits out of numeric order (placed after Phase 35, where it was executed chronologically) — intentionally left unfixed in this PR.
Signed commits via 1Password SSH agent can hang; running git commit in background with TaskOutput polling is the safe pattern for this repo.

code.finding: WR-01: advisory-lock counter uses i32 with abs(), vulnerable to INT_MIN overflow → permanent undeletability. WR-03: stale outbox entries can trigger re-pin race on drain, risking data loss. No resolution section; all 12 WR/IN findings confirmed still open in current code.

WR-06: write journal stores full ciphertext in JSON with no GC or size cap — unbounded growth risk. WR-07: journal replay has no network timeout. Criticals CR-01..CR-08 all verified fixed by 2026-06-14; phases 45/46 closed most warnings.
P29 unenroll flow skips unloaded subtrees — confirmed open, not in BACKLOG.

workflow: Workflow synthesis agents reliably choke on large nested structured-output schemas (292 items → 13-min retry loop on 'must have required property summary/groups'). Better pattern: let sweep agents return raw arrays, stop the workflow early, and synthesize in the main context where BACKLOG cross-referencing is available.
TaskList does not show in-flight workflow agent progress; inspect the workflow transcript directory (ls -lt on the session dir) to gauge which agents are running vs. stuck.

Adversarially verifying candidate tech-debt findings against current code (rather than trusting artifact prose) is essential — it caught phase 43 criticals already fixed and the ledger close-out scope mismatch, preventing both stale filings and false 'already closed' claims.
When a milestone summary claims process gaps were closed, verify the specific commit ranges cover the specific phases before writing it as fact.

friction: Workflow synthesis agent entered an unrecoverable schema-validation retry loop (~13 min) trying to emit 292 deduped items as a single nested StructuredOutput — had to be killed manually via TaskStop.
TaskList returned empty during workflow execution, giving no visibility into agent count or progress; required direct filesystem inspection of transcript directories.
The milestone summary draft overstated that phases 18/31/32 verification gaps were closed (they weren't) — required a correction commit after the fact.
Signed git commits via 1Password SSH can hang the terminal; required background execution + TaskOutput polling rather than a simple blocking git commit.
